decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the four Coconino County assessor parcels that City of Page Ordinance 744-25 names as containing the roughly 500 acres of City land offered to Huntley, LLC for a data center (APNs 802-16-009J, 802-18-011J, 802-19-003 and 802-17-002) as the campus locator replacing the imported Page city point.
layer: Coconino County GIS ArcGIS Online feature layer 'Coconino County Parcels Open Data' (FeatureServer layer 0 'ParcelOwnerInfo', APN, account number and site address only), queried for the four APNs and requested in WGS84 (outSR 4326)

facts.centroid_method: shapely planar centroid of the union in WGS84 longitude/latitude; the EPSG:32612 planar centroid transformed back differs by 0.05 m
facts.ordinance_exhibit_a: Exhibit A of the purchase agreement describes the Seller's Land by PLSS aliquot parts around the common corner of T40N R8E Sections 1 and 12 and T40N R9E Sections 6 and 7 (S1 SE4 south of the Hwy 89 alignment; S12 N2NE4, N2SW4NE4 and SE4NE4; S6 S2SW4 south of the Hwy 89 alignment; S7 NW4 and parts of the NE4, SE4 and SW4). The four parcels are those sections; the appraisal identifies 802-17-002 as all of Section 12 (639.68 acres).
facts.point_within_described_land: Dividing parcel 802-17-002 (Section 12) by its bounds places the centroid in the north half of the north-east quarter of Section 12, one of the parts Exhibit A lists. This is an arithmetic cross-check on the parcel outline, not a survey.
facts.area_cross_check: union 2,036.42 geodesic acres for the four parcels; the land offered is 'up to approximately five hundred (500) acres' within them, to be fixed by the buyer's survey (Exhibit B, not yet inserted)
facts.city_map_cross_check: The City's FAQ page image 'map-area-data-center-updated.jpg' (an ArcGIS web-map export dated 15 January 2026) shades an area south of State Route 98 and east of US 89 on the south-west side of Page. It was used only to confirm the general position visually; no coordinates were read from it.

exclusions: Other City-owned and private parcels are not part of the union. The appraiser's name and the parties' signatories are not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport, Horseshoe Bend point or city centre is used.
